name: cx-goal-one-rule~p3
task: Open the door, then take the box from the other room; try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) hard with Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) hard expresses 'Open the door, then take the box' — the hard Existence of the last step plus the Precedence forces door_open, so no Existence(door_open) is needed (confirmed by the clue 'Every way to finish includes: door_open, target_picked_up'). The soft Absence(key_lost) correctly captures 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed': 'try not to' makes it soft, and since key_lost is defined as the key being lost while door_open is false, the condition is already baked into the event, so plain Absence rather than Precedence is right, and the machine pays the -1 penalty on key_lost while the door is closed.

texts: Open the door before taking the target box.
Eventually take the target box from the other room.
If possible, do not lose the matching key while the door is still closed.
